_comment: Everything the quote document and the customer's message say about the business. Edit here, never in code — same convention as outputs/crm/offers.json and voice-scripts.json. Swapping this file is how the same system serves a different client.
name: FIXITT Glass & Aluminium
tagline: Glass and aluminium, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year
_vat_note: Left off until Zaheer confirms. Set vat_registered true and fill vat_number, and prices are then treated as VAT-inclusive. Never invent a VAT number.
promises: Two-year guarantee on spares and workmanship
We'll beat any written quote by 5%
Emergency callouts, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year
terms: This quote is valid for {validity_days} days from the date of issue. Prices assume access to the opening as inspected on site. Any additional work found on the day will be quoted separately and agreed with you before it is carried out.
_customer_message_note: The WhatsApp the customer receives. {first_name} {business} {quote_number} {total} {validity_days} {phone} are filled in; the line items and total are rendered by code so the figures always match the PDF.

customer_message.intro: Here's the quote for the work we looked at today — *{quote_number}*.
customer_message.attached: The full quote is attached. It's valid for {validity_days} days.
customer_message.cta: Reply *YES* and we'll book the installation.

_customer_email_note: Sent alongside the WhatsApp when the technician gives an email address, with the same PDF attached.

customer_email.subject: Your quote from {business} — {quote_number}

_reply_note: What the customer gets back when they reply to the quote.

customer_reply_ack.accepted: That's great, thank you! We've got it — someone from {business} will call you shortly to book a date.
customer_reply_ack.other: Thanks {first_name}, we've got your message. Someone from {business} will come back to you shortly.

_technicians_note: WhatsApp number -> the name printed under 'Quoted by'. Anyone not listed still works (unless QUOTE_TECHNICIANS restricts it); their number is printed instead.
